_comment: Copy this file to ~/.config/amazon-xhs-poster/config.json (or anywhere and set XHS_AMAZON_CONFIG=<path>). Edit persona / paths / forbidden lists for your account. The skill reads --config <path> first, then $XHS_AMAZON_CONFIG, then the default location.

persona.brand_cn: REPLACE_ME — your Xiaohongshu account brand string in Chinese (e.g. 文森特在美国)
persona.identity: REPLACE_ME — one-line operator backstory (e.g. 西雅图 10 年亚马逊老卖家)
persona.voice: 克制、节制、不卖鸡汤，像在带团队的实战操盘手

_output_language_help: zh = Chinese output (default, optimized for Xiaohongshu native audience). en = English output (for Lemon8 / LinkedIn / X / Instagram). Switching to 'en' auto-defaults must_contain, cta_tokens, and decision_verbs to English equivalents — but you can still override any of those explicitly below.
_platform_help: Target platform — drives title length cap, body cap, hashtag count rules, card count range, and post.md output layout. Choices: 'xiaohongshu' (default; ZH carousel, 6-9 cards, ≤20 char title), 'lemon8' (EN carousel, 6-10 cards, ≤30 char title), 'linkedin' (text-only, 3000-char body, 3-5 hashtags), 'x' (single tweet OR thread via xhs.thread[], 280 char/post, 0-2 hashtags), 'instagram' (1-10 cards + caption, up to 2200 char caption, 5-30 hashtags). See references/platforms.md.
_cta_tokens_help: Optional override. The skill will pick a sensible default for your output_language; specify here only if you need a different vocabulary. ZH default: ['点赞', '收藏', '关注', '不迷路', '评论']. EN default: ['like', 'save', 'follow', 'comment', 'share', 'subscribe'].
_decision_verbs_help: Optional override for the ai-workflow card 5 decision-verb soft-warn. Leave null to use language-default. ZH default: ['决定', '判断', '换', '停', '加预算', '下架', '挑选', '暂停', '转移', '重组', '砍', '上架', '留']. EN default: ['decide', 'switch', 'pause', 'stop', 'increase budget', 'remove', 'select', 'transfer', 'rebuild', 'cut', 'promote', 'keep', 'kill'].
_gated_sources_help: Optional: pull research signal from login-protected services (X, LinkedIn, wearesellers.com) using a persistent Playwright browser profile. First run: `node scripts/fetch-gated.mjs --setup` opens a Chrome window for you to log in once; cookies persist in browser_profile_dir. Daily runs: `node scripts/fetch-gated.mjs --date YYYY-MM-DD` fetches headless, writes <drafts_root>/<DATE>/research/gated-signal.md. RISK: automating logged-in access may violate ToS and can risk account suspension. Use only for personal research; never share cookies. See references/gated-sources.md.

x._handle_help: X usernames cap at 15 chars. 'MarketplacePulse' is 16 chars and doesn't exist — real handle is 'MarketplacePuls' (no e). Verify any new handle directly on x.com before adding. Watch for: handle exists, account active in last 30 days, content matches Amazon-seller / cross-border / retail-analyst topic.

linkedin._help: Use the linkedin.com/in/<slug>/ slug from the URL bar — visit the profile in your browser to copy. Watch for: (a) slug collisions on common names ('dharmeshmehta' redirects to a different Dharmesh; the Amazon VP is at 'dharmeshmmehta' with double m). (b) Auto-generated slugs with a numeric ID suffix (e.g. 'andy-jassy-8b1615') — those are the canonical URLs even when a vanity-style 'andyjassy' looks more memorable. (c) Don't reuse X handles for LinkedIn slugs — they're separate platforms (Juozas Kaziukenas is @juokaz on X but /in/juozas/ on LinkedIn).
